items.meaning: A shop places the next-day order from a phone or the shop PC until 16:00.
The order form shows the previous order so it can be copied and adjusted.
Products out of production that day are shown greyed out, not hidden.
The central bakery sees all orders in one list by 16:15 and can print it per oven line.
A shop manager can set a standing order per weekday, created automatically unless changed by 15:30.
Order confirmation with totals goes to the shop by SMS and email.
At closing the shop records what was thrown away per product and a report compares it with the order.
The order form also shows the same weekday of the previous week.
The allergen list per product is visible in the order form.
Prices are set centrally; shops cannot edit them.
If the bakery cannot deliver the full quantity, the shop is told before 06:00 what is short.
The driver scans the crate label at drop-off so the shop knows the order arrived.
Unsold bread returned to the central bakery for the animal feed partner is counted per crate.
Owners see sales, orders and wastage per shop per week on a dashboard.
Roles: shop manager, shop staff (order only), bakery planner, driver, owner.
The shop can keep ordering offline and it syncs when the connection returns.
The order cut-off time can differ per shop.
A shortage notice names the replacement product when there is one.

must_not_invent: WhatsApp confirmation as a requirement (it is a question in the source)
